transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me a little bit about what has been bothering you lately and what brings you to see me today?

I've just been feeling incredibly down and sad lately, like there's this constant emptiness inside me. It has been going on for about three months now, and I just can't seem to shake it. That's really the main reason I decided to come in today.
Have you ever experienced periods lasting several days where you felt unusually energetic, restless, or impulsive, to the point where you needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I've never felt that way at all. I have never had periods where I felt unusually energetic, impulsive, or like I didn't need sleep. If anything, I just feel completely drained and exhausted all the time.
Have you felt this way consistently every single day for the past three months, or have there been periods where your mood felt relatively normal or better?

Yes, I have felt this way consistently every single day for the past three months. There haven't been any days where my mood felt normal or even slightly better. It just feels like a constant, heavy cloud that never lifts.
Besides feeling sad and empty, have you noticed other changes, such as significant changes in your appetite, difficulty sleeping, or a loss of interest in activities you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and activities I used to enjoy, and nothing seems to bring me pleasure anymore. As for my appetite and sleep, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in those areas.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or difficulty concentrating on your daily tasks lately?

I haven't really experienced feelings of worthlessness or guilt, and my concentration seems to be okay for the most part. It's really just the constant sadness, emptiness, and total lack of interest in everything that's been weighing on me.
Have you ever felt this way for a period of two years or longer, or has this persistent low mood only been happening for these past three months?
No, I've never felt this way for two years or longer. This persistent low mood has really only been happening for these past three months.
